findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: siteborne_web_context_verified, siteborne_document_evidence_json, siteborne_verify_agent_output · Private data: siteborne_company_evidence_graph, siteborne_web_context_verified, siteborne_document_evidence_json, siteborne_verify_agent_output, siteborne_get_service_health · Public sink: siteborne_document_evidence_json · Destructive: siteborne_get_quote.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: siteborne_web_context_verified, siteborne_document_evidence_json, siteborne_verify_agent_output · Private data: siteborne_company_evidence_graph, siteborne_web_context_verified, siteborne_document_evidence_json, siteborne_verify_agent_output, siteborne_get_service_health · Public sink: siteborne_document_evidence_json · Destructive: siteborne_get_quote

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
